from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CurrentLiability(BaseModel):
    """A company's reported total current liabilities from one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    liability_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label for total current liabilities as written in the report, e.g. '流动负债合计'")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical amount reported for total current liabilities")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount, e.g. '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period or date, e.g. '2024 年 1 月 1 日至 2024 年 3 月 31 日'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt showing the label and amount from the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    current_liabilities: list[CurrentLiability]
